items.title: August 2027 Peach Lettering
items.alt: Coral August lettering arches over whole and halved peaches above green 2027 numerals.
items.description: A detailed peach stone and glossy green leaves give the fruit cluster a clear focal point between the month and year.

items.title: September 2027 Books and Pencil
items.alt: Plum September lettering curves above three stacked books and a yellow pencil, with gold 2027 numerals below.
items.description: Mustard, plum and teal covers form a compact book stack, contrasted by the large sharpened pencil leaning across its right edge.

items.title: Level Up in 2027 Gaming Controller
items.alt: A silver and navy game controller rises behind orange Level Up lettering and angular blue 2027 numerals.
items.description: Two thumbsticks, a directional pad and colored face buttons give the controller a clear shape above the bold gaming slogan and small pixel star.

items.title: Iridescent Gel 2027
items.alt: Glossy rounded 2027 numerals with flowing iridescent highlights, arranged as 20 above a sweeping 27.
items.description: Amber, pink, violet and blue reflections follow the soft inflated strokes around the open zero.

items.title: October 2027 Pumpkin and Oak Leaves
items.alt: An orange pumpkin stands beside brown October lettering above copper 2027 numerals and autumn oak leaves.
items.description: The curved pumpkin stem and sweeping branch line frame the warm metal-like year without obscuring the large month name.

items.title: November 2027 Wheat and Acorn Banner
items.alt: A cream November banner crosses two golden wheat stems above green 2027 numerals and paired acorns.
items.description: The crossed grain stalks form a tall open silhouette, while brown textured acorn caps and small oak leaves finish its base.
